metadata.title: Can Teacher AI Literacy Reach Those Who Need It Most? Professional Learning, Realised Access, and Cumulative Advantage in TALIS 2024

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not measure cognitive achievement scores with Plausible Values, as it focuses on teachers' self-reported participation in AI-related professional learning.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that it incorporates teacher sampling weights in all multilevel models.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study uses three-level multilevel linear probability models, which account for the clustering of teachers within schools.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any external validation strategies and only discusses internal validation methods.
